{"reason": "Split the costly medium/high branch into inventory bands: <4.5 days → alert-planner (transfers/alt arrive late: inv 2.8/5.3 stockouts at 195000); ≥9 days → monitor (regular-lead ≤8 beats inv 10–13.2 rows, cost 0 vs 45000); 4.5–9 days → propose-internal-rebalance (6000, transfers 2–4 days arrive in time vs 45000 switches).", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 4.5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (>= inventory-days 9.0))
     (list 'monitor))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'propose-internal-rebalance))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
